notes: preset = gradient map: curve = a*,b* per lightness bin of the lines (centres LC; identity, swatches), lq = lightness at grey levels Q (0..1, 201 steps, glow included), lut = a*,b* over lightness LC x opacity AC x distance from centre RC (used by tint). style = median core_gain (L*) and glow_px of its icons. group key: damage/<DamageType> when VerbalIntent is Damage, else <Spell|Action>/<intent>, then intent/<intent>; presets listed by share among training icons, default first. two_tone: icon -> [[preset, dE2000] of its first part (the metamagic drop), of its second], parts by stroke (glyph.part_presets, D26).
